correctness.rationale: For δ=p−1, λ=2j(2j+n−2), k=n−p, and |a_j|=|Γ((n+p)/2)/Γ(−p/2)|Γ(j−p/2)/Γ(j+(n+p)/2), uniform compact-p Gamma ratios yield c_n j^{−(n+2)/2}(1+o(1)). In the joint region δj^(n+2)→τ finite, δj²→0 and D_j∼4j²/(n−1), hence two normalized coefficient terms are τ/(n−1)^2 and (n+1)c_n². Their difference is (τ−T_n)/(n−1)^2. An upper test j≈(1+η)(T_n/δ)^(1/(n+2)) and uniform positivity of R_j−1 for all smaller j—including separate bounded-j cases—sandwich the first positive j. Real-reading of Feng–Zhang Proposition3.3 and eq.(3.14) confirms B_j is a sufficient coefficient only; no negative-B impossibility, uniform epsilon, or interchange of fixed-p and joint limits is claimed.
